note: Classifies every job of every workflow in .github/workflows for `make ci-local` (scripts/cilocal). The runner reads the commands from the workflow files, so a step that is not listed here runs locally exactly as CI writes it. List a job under "jobs" the moment you add it to a workflow: `go test ./scripts/cilocal` fails (and so does CI) for any workflow, job, or step that cannot run as written and is not classified, and for any entry here that no longer matches a workflow. Per job: "skip" says why it cannot run on a developer machine; "requires" names tools whose absence skips the job with that reason; "os" limits it to hosts it can run on; "steps" classifies single steps by name with exactly one of "skip" (a check that did not run, counted and shown), "command" (a local stand-in, with "why"), "covered" (another step's command does this step's work) or "bookkeeping" (CI plumbing with no check in it). Actions that only set a runner up are listed under "plumbing"; any other action in a runnable job must be classified because an action cannot be executed locally. Never add a "skip" to make a failing check go away: a skip is for what a laptop cannot do.

initialize CodeQL.skip: CodeQL's analysis only exists on GitHub's hosted runners; the build step below still runs

analyze.skip: CodeQL's analysis only exists on GitHub's hosted runners; the build step below still runs

security.yml/dependency-review.skip: needs the repository's GitHub dependency graph and the pull request's diff, which only exist on GitHub

scan the changed files.command: git fetch -q origin main && ./scripts/supply-chain-scan.sh "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
scan the changed files.why: CI diffs the pull request's base against GITHUB_SHA; locally the base is the merge base with origin/main and the head is HEAD

explain a failure in the job summary.bookkeeping: writes a job summary when the scan above fails

security.yml/main-health.skip: reads the latest workflow runs on main through the GitHub API (needs gh and the repository's Actions history); it only warns

suggest dictionary additions.bookkeeping: writes a job summary when the spellcheck above fails

check internal links.why: the workflow's lychee action runs exactly this lychee invocation (its fail: true makes a broken link fail the job, as lychee's exit status does here)

links.yml/external.skip: runs only on the weekly schedule or by hand, needs the network, and only reports broken links

publish coverage.bookkeeping: uploads coverage.out to Codecov; the floors are checked by the step before it

install buf.bookkeeping: downloads a pinned Linux x86-64 buf into the runner; locally buf is a prerequisite of this job, listed under requires

a good entry passes.why: action-test builds the same CLI image and drives integrations/action/verify.sh with the same three cases (a good entry, an unsigned entry, a wrong expected arm) that the next four steps run through the composite action

ci-sdk-main.yml/sdk-main.skip: runs `go get github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk@main`, which rewrites go.mod and go.sum; run those steps by hand in a throwaway checkout

e2e.yml/e2e.skip: scheduled or by hand: submits live transactions to Stellar testnet and files an issue on a regression; `make e2e` is the manual equivalent

e2e.yml/e2e-local.skip: by hand only: needs a local Stellar quickstart container and stellar-cli; `make e2e-local` is the manual equivalent

fuzz.yml/fuzz.skip: the nightly long run of the targets ci-go.yml/fuzz already runs for 30 seconds each; it files an issue on a finding

fuzz.yml/soak.skip: the scheduled ten-minute soak; `make soak` is the local smoke

cost-report.yml/report.skip: reads the repository's Actions usage through the GitHub API

reproducible.yml/reproduce.skip: rebuilds a published release and compares it with the checksums attached to that release

verify-release.yml/verify.skip: verifies the signatures and attestations of a published release with cosign and the GitHub API

verify-release.yml/self-test.skip: by hand only: keyless-signs a throwaway binary with the workflow's GitHub OIDC identity

release.yml/release-preflight.skip: release workflow: runs when a version tag is pushed

release.yml/golden-drift.skip: release workflow: runs when a version tag is pushed (ci.yml/golden-drift is the same check)

release.yml/build.skip: release workflow: builds and keyless-signs the release binaries when a version tag is pushed

release.yml/image.skip: release workflow: pushes and signs the container image when a version tag is pushed

release.yml/image-smoke.skip: release workflow: pulls the image it just published

release.yml/packaging.skip: release workflow: renders the Homebrew formula and flake for the release and commits them

release.yml/wasm-parity.skip: release workflow: runs when a version tag is pushed (ci-wasm.yml/wasm is the same check)

release.yml/npm.skip: release workflow: publishes the npm package with provenance

release.yml/docs-site.skip: release workflow: publishes the documentation site to gh-pages

release.yml/release.skip: release workflow: creates the GitHub release and attests its assets

release.yml/verify-release.skip: release workflow: verifies the release it just published
